_comment: Pterodactyl egg for foreverdoscrias NeoForge server packs.
name: foreverdoscrias NeoForge
author: admin@example.com
description: Installs the foreverdoscrias CurseForge server pack from a GitHub Release asset and runs it with NeoForge.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update
apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl jq unzip openjdk-21-jre-headless

cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${SERVER_PACK_URL}" ]; then
  echo "SERVER_PACK_URL is required. Upload the server zip to a GitHub Release and paste the asset URL into this variable." >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "Downloading server pack from ${SERVER_PACK_URL}"
curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o server-pack.zip "${SERVER_PACK_URL}"

echo "Extracting overrides and manifest"
rm -rf pack-extract
mkdir -p pack-extract mods
unzip -q server-pack.zip -d pack-extract
if [ ! -f pack-extract/manifest.json ]; then
  echo "manifest.json was not found in the server pack zip." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ -d pack-extract/overrides ]; then
  cp -R pack-extract/overrides/. /mnt/server/
fi
cp pack-extract/manifest.json /mnt/server/manifest.json

MC_VERSION=$(jq -r '.minecraft.version' manifest.json)
MANIFEST_LOADER=$(jq -r '.minecraft.modLoaders[] | select(.primary == true) | .id' manifest.json | head -n 1)
if [ -z "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ] || [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
  MINECRAFT_VERSION="${MC_VERSION}"
fi
if [ -z "${NEOFORGE_VERSION}" ] || [ "${NEOFORGE_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
  NEOFORGE_VERSION="${MANIFEST_LOADER#neoforge-}"
fi

echo "Installing NeoForge ${NEOFORGE_VERSION} for Minecraft ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
NEOFORGE_INSTALLER="neoforge-${NEOFORGE_VERSION}-installer.jar"
curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o "${NEOFORGE_INSTALLER}" "https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/neoforge/${NEOFORGE_VERSION}/neoforge-${NEOFORGE_VERSION}-installer.jar"
java -jar "${NEOFORGE_INSTALLER}" --installServer
rm -f "${NEOFORGE_INSTALLER}"

echo "Downloading CurseForge manifest mods"
jq -c '.files[]' manifest.json | while read -r file; do
  PROJECT_ID=$(echo "${file}" | jq -r '.projectID')
  FILE_ID=$(echo "${file}" | jq -r '.fileID')
  URL="https://www.curseforge.com/api/v1/mods/${PROJECT_ID}/files/${FILE_ID}/download"
  FINAL_URL=$(curl -fLs -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective}' "${URL}")
  FILENAME=$(basename "${FINAL_URL%%\?*}")
  if [ -z "${FILENAME}" ] || [ "${FILENAME}" = "download" ]; then
    FILENAME="${PROJECT_ID}-${FILE_ID}.jar"
  fi
  if [ -f "mods/${FILENAME}" ]; then
    echo "Already exists: ${FILENAME}"
    continue
  fi
  echo "Downloading ${FILENAME}"
  curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o "mods/${FILENAME}" "${URL}"
done

MOD_COUNT=$(find mods -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.jar' | wc -l)
echo "Installed ${MOD_COUNT} mod jars"
if [ "${MOD_COUNT}" -lt 50 ]; then
  echo "The mods directory looks incomplete. Check the installer log for CurseForge download failures." >&2
  exit 1
fi

cat > eula.txt <<'EOF'
eula=true
EOF

rm -rf pack-extract server-pack.zip

echo "Install complete."

variables.name: Server Pack URL
variables.description: Direct URL to the CurseForge server zip uploaded as a GitHub Release asset.

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: Minecraft version. Leave as 1.21.1 for this pack.

variables.name: NeoForge Version
variables.description: NeoForge version. Leave as 21.1.228 for this pack.

variables.name: Max RAM Percentage
variables.description: Maximum percentage of assigned container memory Java may use.

variables.name: ZGC Argument
variables.description: Garbage collector argument. Use -XX:+UseZGC for this pack.
